anomalies.observed: On the root sheet 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block, the 22 nF capacitor C8, the 1 kΩ series resistor R6, and BOTH hierarchical labels NET0017 and NET0018 are tied to a single node (the two label boxes are stacked on the same wire that also joins C8's bottom plate and R6's left terminal). NET0017 is the electrode line on U2 pin 57 (PB5) and NET0018 is the sampling line on U2 pin 59 (PB7), so PB5 and PB7 are shorted together and the 22 nF cap sits on the electrode node.
anomalies.expected: The specification defines two separate nets: TSC_G2_IO2 = PB5 - R8(1 kΩ series) - electrode BTN, and TSC_G2_IO4 = PB7 - C14(22 nF to GND) as the sampling capacitor. The sampling capacitor must hang only off the dedicated sampling IO (PB7), and the electrode IO (PB5) must see only the series resistor to the pad, with the two group-2 IOs kept apart.

evidence.quote: Page 1, 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)': C8 22n (top plate to GND) and R6 1k and the two stacked labels NET0018 / NET0017 all connect to one wire node; R6 right end to A3 pin 1 BTN. MCU right column shows PB5(57)=NET0017 and PB7(59)=NET0018.
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) - R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) - A2 pin "BTN"; TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) - C14 (22 nF to GND) - this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group.

anomalies.impact: The two Touch Sensing Controller group-2 IOs are bridged and the 22 nF sampling capacitor is loaded onto the electrode line instead of the dedicated sampling pin. The capacitive touch button will not function correctly (the sense electrode is shorted to the sampling pin and heavily capacitively loaded), so user touch input is lost.

parsed.summary: The build otherwise matches the specification's topology and values (NFC/display I2C pull-ups, BS strap, charge-pump caps, antenna '??' cap, SWD header all read as intended), but the capacitive-touch block merges the electrode net (PB5/NET0017) with the sampling-capacitor net (PB7/NET0018) and places the 22 nF cap on the electrode node, contradicting the spec's two separate TSC group-2 nets.
